name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created the example script, and ran it. The API call to text_to_speech.convert() succeeded and generated a valid 41KB MP3 audio file (output.mp3) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." File was verified as a real MPEG ADTS Layer III audio file at 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, monaural.
deviations: The quickstart uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since the sandbox has no audio output, I substituted `save(audio, "output.mp3")` to save the generated audio to a file instead. This is the only deviation; the core API authentication, SDK usage, and text-to-speech generation followed the docs exactly.
